Answer: B
Reason: Comparing Figure 1b (1988) and Figure 1c (recent), the cystic lesion in the right lower lobe has clearly increased in size. The new band-like structure visible in the upper third of the cyst in Figure 1c represents a pulmonary vessel traversing the lesion, which is a critical finding indicating a risk for air embolism if the cyst communicates with the vasculature or is intervened upon.
